title: CLC 11th Anniversary Concert in Hong Kong (ft. OT7)
description:
12 years of CLC, and somehow, we’re still here.

After everything we’ve been through, getting to stand on stage together again and celebrate this journey with Cheshire means more to me than words can explain. Hong Kong was such a special moment for all of us, and I’m so grateful we got to create these memories together again. From the behind-the-scenes chaos to the moments on stage, I wanted to share a little bit of what this experience was like with you guys.

Thank you to everyone who has stayed with us throughout the years. No matter how much time passes or where life takes us, a part of CLC will always be with us!

#CLC #CLC12thAnniversary #Cheshire
